_note: Every limit and word list hook.py uses. Frames live in data/templates.json.

output._note: One entry per shape, only for shapes the text can carry. No fixed run size, no number quota.

subhead._note: Write Build Scale's 2026 subtitles: one short sentence, from 'Here are the secrets.' (4 words) to about 16.

numbers._note: Every number in a slot or the subhead must appear in the source text. Four-digit years are exempt.

_banned_note: Ships with one word family. Add your own AI tells; hook.py fails any title or subhead that uses one.
